_comment_repos: Optional. When the MCP tool is given a repo URL it ingests directly. This list is only used by the legacy CLI / future declarative ingest. Leave empty for pure MCP-driven workflows.
_comment_ignoreDirs: Directories skipped by FileScanner regardless of file type. Lockfiles, binaries, and >2MB files are skipped automatically — these are coarser filters.
_comment_supportedExtensions: Override the default extension set. Comment out to use DEFAULT_SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS from packages/shared/src/constants.ts (covers ~25 langs + .sql/.proto/.graphql/.md).
_comment_mcpAdapters: External MCP adapters that fan out from the agent. Each adapter is OFF by default. Set `enabled: true` AND populate the matching env var(s) in .env to activate. ${VAR} values are pulled from process.env at startup.

mcpAdapters._doc: Datadog — direct REST adapter (no spawned MCP server). Capabilities: per-service metrics (traces.errors, hits, duration.p99), error stack-trace search via APM spans, monitor/alert listing.

Atlassian (Jira + Confluence) — spawns an external MCP server via stdio. The default is the community @aashari/mcp-server-atlassian-jira; replace with whatever your team has standardised on. Tools called: confluence_search, jira_search.

config._doc: Override the upstream tool names if you swap in a different MCP server.

mcpAdapters._doc: Mixpanel — wrapped MCP server for product/usage data. Tool called: query_event_counts. Override config.tools.getUsage if your server names it differently.
Grafana Loki — wrapped MCP server for log queries (LogQL). Tool called: query_logs. Service-name → label mapping below maps EKG `Service.name` to the Loki `app` label.
